# Bhubaneswar Assembly constituency

Bhubaneswar was a constituency of the Odisha Legislative Assembly of the Khordha district, Odisha state in India. It was established in 1951 and abolished in 2008. It was replaced and subsumed by the Bhubaneswar Central Assembly constituency.
